nodes.description: The CSC (CFAP61, CFAP91 and CFAP251 with calmodulin) sits at the base of radial spoke 3 and links it to the doublet microtubules. Loss of any one subunit destabilizes the others: CFAP251 is absent from sperm of men with CFAP61 variants, and in Cfap61 knockout spermatids radial spoke assembly is impaired. In Tetrahymena, FAP61-null cilia lack part of the RS3 stem.
